summary.para: Retrieves one or more Windows Known Folders.
Gets objects representing Windows Shell Known Folders. Results can be filtered by name, GUID, value, or by the built-in per-user, public, or all-folders parameter sets.

summary.para: Redirects (moves) a Windows Known Folder to a new path.

Calls the Shell Known Folder redirection API to change where a Known Folder is stored on disk. Supports moving a single folder by value or multiple folders from the pipeline, with optional data migration, read-only probing via -CheckOnly, and pass-through output.

member.summary: Gets or sets the new absolute path for the folder (single-folder parameter set).

member.summary: Gets or sets the Known Folder piped from the pipeline (multiple-folders parameter set).
